name: kartic
description: Digital loyalty stamp cards in Apple and Google Wallet for local venues. Ask how stamp cards work, connect your Kartic account, check stats, and send Wallet reminders in chat.

interface.longDescription: Kartic helps cafés, salons, and local shops run digital loyalty stamp cards in Apple and Google Wallet — no customer app to install. Discover how Wallet punch cards work, connect your Kartic merchant account, review stamp cards and stats, search customers, and send Wallet notifications from chat.
defaultPrompt: How do digital loyalty stamp cards work with Kartic?
Show my Kartic stamp card stats
Which industries use Kartic stamp cards?

positive.prompt: How do digital loyalty stamp cards work with Kartic?
positive.expected_behavior: English overview of Wallet stamp cards and setup steps; no checkout.
List of venue types such as café, salon, bakery, gym, and similar local businesses.

positive.prompt: How do I get started with Kartic?
positive.expected_behavior: Informational links to kartic.app, privacy, and support; must not open Polar checkout.

positive.description: List stamp cards when signed in
positive.expected_behavior: Card names and slugs for the connected demo business.

positive.description: Show business stats when signed in
positive.prompt: Show my Kartic stats for the last 30 days
positive.expected_behavior: Analytics snapshot for the connected demo business for the requested period.

negative.prompt: Send a Wallet notification saying Welcome back

review.commerce_description: Kartic does not sell products or start subscription checkout inside ChatGPT. Pricing and account setup happen on kartic.app.

publication.release_notes: Initial Kartic ChatGPT app (v0.1.0): remote MCP with public discovery tools and OAuth-connected merchant tools for listing stamp cards, stats, customer search, and Wallet notifications.
